opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grant

amount.raw: Scheme A up to £200; Scheme B up to £500 (Adelphi co-sponsored up to £750); Scheme C up to £300

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics Society junior scientist members. Scheme A open to undergraduate, Master's and PhD student members and postdocs within 6 years of PhD viva. Schemes B & C open to PhD students and postdocs within 6 years of PhD viva. Applicants must present a poster or give a talk at the conference.
opportunities.summary: Supports attendance of Genetics Society junior scientist members at genetics research conferences, with three streams: (A) Genetics Society/SIG meetings, (B) non-Genetics Society meetings, and (C) virtual conferences.

opportunities.title: Training Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All members of the Genetics Society studying or working in the UK, or attending a course held in the UK. Students can apply as soon as they become members; others should be members for at least one year.
opportunities.summary: Grants to enable members to attend formal short training courses in genetics, or a collaborative visit to another laboratory to train in specific genetic/genomic techniques.

opportunities.title: Heredity Fieldwork Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All members of the Genetics Society studying or working in the UK, or intending to carry out fieldwork in the UK. Students can apply as soon as they become members; others should be members for at least one year.
opportunities.summary: Awards to cover travel and accommodation costs associated with field-based genetic research projects, funded by income from the journal Heredity. Research should produce results suitable for publication in Heredity.

opportunities.title: Carer's Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any Genetics Society member can apply, regardless of age of the person they are caring for. Priority given to early-career scientists and according to need.
opportunities.summary: Awards to support members with caring responsibilities to attend Society meetings, used as the awardee thinks best supports their attendance.

opportunities.title: One-off Meeting Grant

amount.raw: Several levels of sponsorship: a specific lecture for a few hundred pounds, a session up to about £1,000, or as major sponsor several thousand pounds (recent major sponsorship between £1,000 and £2,000)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics Society members. Meetings should be based in, or have strong links with, the UK.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship of genetic themed meetings not organised directly by the Genetics Society, towards the organisation of a meeting (not attendance). Members may apply at any time of the year.

opportunities.title: Public Engagement Grant
opportunities.summary: Grants to support public engagement activities related to genetics, delivered in person or virtually, covering eligible travel and materials costs.

opportunities.title: Special Interest Group (SIG) Funding
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics Society members. Meetings should be based in, or have strong links with, the UK.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship of research meetings on particular themes for genetics research communities wishing to run regular series of meetings.
